See also: fòbia, fóbia, fobią, -fòbia, -fóbia, -fobia, and -fobią

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism, ultimately from Ancient Greek [Term?] (see English phobia).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfobiɑ/, [ˈfo̞biɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -obiɑ
  • Syllabification(key): fo‧bi‧a
  • Hyphenation(key): fo‧bia

Noun

[edit]

fobia

  1. phobia (irrational or obsessive fear or anxiety of a specific thing)
    Synonym: määräkohteinen pelko

Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
fobia
Wikipedia it

Etymology

[edit]

Noun use of the suffix -fobia, from Ancient Greek -φοβία (-phobía), combining form of φόβος (phóbos, “fear”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Rhymes: -ia
  • IPA(key): /foˈbi.a/
  • Rhymes: -ia
  • Hyphenation: fo‧bì‧a

Noun

[edit]

fobia f (plural fobie)

  1. phobia
    fobia di (qualcosa) ― phobia of/about (something)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • fobico

Related terms

[edit]
  • -fobia
  • -fobo
  • foberismo

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Fabio, foiba
